specification_name: Consolidated Application Themes and Accessibility Requirements
purpose: Self-contained instructions and color tokens for another coding AI to implement in an existing application.

scope.note: Contrast Light and Comfort are mandatory, following the final user instruction. No theme in this file is optional.

implementation_contract.platform: Framework-neutral: map to CSS variables, native resources or shared theme objects as appropriate.
implementation_contract.historical_alias_policy: Use former names only for migration; display the final names in the theme selector.
source_priority: Explicit accessibility and operating-system user preferences.
Historical source CSS for provenance, never as an override of resolved readable colors.
implementation_contract.token_resolution: Every theme includes concrete colors. No external attachments or references are required to resolve tokens. shared_rules apply to all themes.
implementation_contract.state_resolution: Use the selected component state object. Keyboard focus is a separate additive outline; it must coexist with hover, pressed or selected styling. Disabled controls cannot be activated.
implementation_contract.button_policy: Standard, primary and secondary buttons deliberately share the dark outlined treatment in dark appearance themes. Primary priority may be conveyed by placement, icon or weight; do not replace every standard button with a bright filled button.
implementation_contract.accessibility_priority: A theme alone does not provide complete accessibility. Implement all shared accessibility settings and verify the actual application.
implementation_contract.persistence: Switch immediately without losing application state. Persist theme and accessibility settings separately. Legacy System selections migrate to Steel.

visual_language: Professional consistent application layout and control shapes.
Dark backgrounds, colored text and visible colored borders define the six original appearance themes.
Stronger background colors appear on hover or active states; keep semantic action distinctions.
High-contrast and Comfort themes intentionally override decorative treatments.
button_requirements: Use explicit background, foreground and border colors for every supplied state.
Use the foreground token for icons as well as text.
Keep visible borders and additive focus outlines; never rely only on shadows.
Do not convey destructive action only through a red color.
Disabled controls retain readable labels and an explicit disabled state.
focus_requirements: Use a visible 3 px outline with a 2 px contrasting gap or native equivalent.
Verify outline contrast against actual adjacent backgrounds and adjust locally if needed.
Prevent focus outlines from being clipped or obscured.
table_requirements: Use subtle alternating rows in appearance themes and clear separators in contrast themes.
Provide distinct hover and selection styles with an additional selection marker.

contrast_policy.note: Validate every actual state and adjacent surface. Decorative separators need not reach the essential-indicator target. Disabled text has an accessibility-standard exception, but this specification keeps it readable.

themes.name: Gold
themes.description: Black and charcoal surfaces, warm metallic gold text and detailing, restrained steel-blue secondary accents. Elegant and professional.
design_constraints: Preserve gold accents #DAA520 and #FFD700.
Use steel blue #3C5A7A as a secondary accent.
Preserve original table rows #181818 and #23231B.

provenance.note: Page palettes and missing interaction states are specified extensions. Historical custom properties are preserved separately. Readability fixes take precedence over literal reproduction.

contrast_targets.scope: Verify actual adjacent backgrounds in all states. Subtle decorative separators are not essential indicators. These targets do not certify full WCAG conformance.

inputs.invalid_indicator: Explicit error message plus error icon; never border color alone.

tables.selection_indicator: Checkmark or visible selected marker, exposed to assistive technology.

navigation.active_indicator: Persistent marker and programmatic current/selected state.

effects.frosted_fallback: Opaque panel color; validate composited contrast.

requirements: Never communicate status, selection, errors or action meaning through color alone.
Use text labels and meaningful icons; use patterns or line styles in charts.
Retain explicit labels for Save, Edit, Delete and Buy in every theme.
Allow independent text scaling and user text-spacing preferences.
Support at least 200% text resizing and test 400% zoom/reflow where applicable.
Avoid clipped labels, fixed-height text containers and loss of functionality.
Use a clear system or readable sans-serif font, without thin text weights.
Do not claim a particular font universally addresses dyslexia.
Offer comfortable control sizing and spacing independently of theme.
Aim for at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels or equivalent logical units for interactive targets; adapt dense interfaces with adequate spacing.
Maintain full keyboard operation and visible focus without requiring precise pointer movement.
Remove nonessential movement, animated backgrounds, parallax and animated theme transitions when enabled.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion in web applications or the native system equivalent.
Avoid flashing effects in every theme.
Suppress decorative backgrounds, gradients, transparency, blur, glow and nonessential shadows.
Preserve familiar layout, navigation, essential controls and task information.
Respect user-selected operating-system contrast palettes.
In web applications support forced-colors and system color keywords.
Do not globally disable forced-color adjustments to preserve the application palette.
Keep focus and controls identifiable when shadows or background images are removed.
Use native semantic controls where available, accessible names, labels and exposed states.
Provide logical keyboard order, keyboard-operable dialogs and reliable focus management.
Announce important status changes appropriately without excessive interruptions.
Do not hide essential controls until hover or depend on tooltips as the only label.

validation.generated_button_and_pagination_text_con: All checked pairs meet their theme text target, including the specified disabled palette.
limitations: Static opaque token-pair validation only; the target application has not been implemented or tested.
Audit real UI composition, text scaling, keyboard flow, screen readers, forced colors, focus, charts and other states before claiming accessibility conformance.
acceptance_checks: All nine mandatory themes appear in the selector under their final names.
No buttons, borders, dropdowns, dialogs or scrollbars retain unintended framework defaults.
All component states use theme tokens and are visually distinguishable.
All mandatory accessibility settings operate independently of the chosen theme.
Contrast and Contrast Light meet the enhanced text targets in actual rendered states.
Zoom, text spacing and comfortable controls do not clip or hide information.
Keyboard focus, assistive technology and operating-system contrast settings remain usable.
Theme changes and accessibility preferences persist separately.
